  </div>
  <script id="indzuf">
    // FAQ accordion sem depender de <details>
  document.querySelectorAll('#acai-page .ax-faq-q').forEach(function(btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var answer = this.nextElementSibling;
      var icon   = this.querySelector('span');
      var isOpen = answer.classList.contains('open');
      // fecha todos
      document.querySelectorAll('#acai-page .ax-faq-a').forEach(function(a) { a.classList.remove('open'); });
      document.querySelectorAll('#acai-page .ax-faq-q span').forEach(function(s) { s.style.transform = 'rotate(0deg)'; });
      // abre o clicado
      if (!isOpen) {
        answer.classList.add('open');
        icon.style.transform = 'rotate(45deg)';
      }
    });
  });
  </script>
</body>
